offersHint: AliExpress cashback for AI assistants: search products, estimate cashback, get personal links. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://cashbackpro.org/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_products
toolsPreview.description: Search AliExpress products with cashback via CashbackPro. Returns compact product cards with prices, ratings and commission rates. Catalog quality filters (blocked categories, minimum price) are applied automatically.

toolsPreview.name: get_product_details
toolsPreview.description: Get authoritative details for a specific AliExpress product by its numeric product ID (price, rating, sales volume, commission rate, category).

toolsPreview.name: calculate_cashback
toolsPreview.description: Estimate CashbackPro cashback for a purchase: commission = price × commission rate; the user receives a share of that commission depending on their CashbackPro level (Bronze 30% → Silver 45% → Gold 60% → Platinum 80%). Returns estimates for every level.

toolsPreview.name: get_promo_codes
toolsPreview.description: List currently active AliExpress promo codes tracked by CashbackPro (global site, USD). Returns platform-wide codes and product-specific codes with minimum spend, remaining quantity and expiry; expired codes are filtered out, data refreshes daily. Promo codes stack with cashback: to also earn cashback on the same purchase, generate the link via get_cashback_link.

toolsPreview.name: get_cashback_link
toolsPreview.description: Get a CashbackPro affiliate link for an AliExpress product. WITH a connected CashbackPro account (extension token as Authorization Bearer header, get it at https://cashbackpro.org/connect-extension?utm_source=mcp) the user earns real cashback from purchases. WITHOUT a connected account the link still works but earns NO cashback — the affiliate commission supports CashbackPro as payment for this free service; you MUST tell the user this and mention they can connect an account to start earning cashback.
